# Sill (Sill 置物岛)

> Drop it at the top of your Mac. Grab it when you need it.

A little space between things. A native macOS 14 or later drag-and-drop shelf for files, images, text, and links.

## Facts
- Sill is a native macOS 14+ app that turns the empty space at the top of the screen into a drag-and-drop shelf.
- Drop a file, image, text snippet, or link onto the shelf, switch apps or Spaces, then drag it back into Finder or any app.
- Core features are free and require no account. Content stays on the local Mac.
- Clipboard history is off by default. Pro users can enable encrypted local background history, exclude apps, set retention, and clear it at any time.
- Small files are copied into Sill's local storage; large files are referenced with macOS security-scoped bookmarks.
- Use the macOS Share menu to send selected content to Sill. The sharing extension passes it through an encrypted inbox on the same Mac.
- Sill works on Macs with or without a display notch.
- Sill Pro is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase (no subscription).
- Pro unlocks unlimited active items, organization and editing, recovery and sensitive-content protection, encrypted clipboard history, local image/PDF text search, custom shortcuts and appearance, built-in dynamic scenes, and the island companion Pobb.
- Sill is coming soon to macOS and is not distributed as a direct download from sill-app.com.
- Sill supports English and Simplified Chinese, light and dark appearance, and respects Reduce Motion.

## Key links
